$comment: BambooHR's managed dropdown lists for Urban Infraconstruction, captured 2026-09-09. These are the CLOSED SETS behind the Add Employee form's Job Title, Department and Division selects — not free text. Captured by element inspection in BambooHR's own UI because the API key returns 403 on /meta/lists, so the API cannot enumerate them. That 403 is the reason this file exists: it is the only machine-readable copy we have. Re-capture the same way if BambooHR's lists change, or delete this file if the key ever gains metadata access and the sync can read them directly.
source: BambooHR UI element inspection (Add Employee form), company domain: urban
why: Job title must be mapped to Optix team-role tiers. A closed set means that mapping is a table filled in once; free text would need a permanent unmapped queue. The dropdowns prove it is closed.

jobTitles.$comment: 131 options, no duplicates. The whole list, including titles nobody currently holds — 87 were in use by current staff as of 2026-09-09. Arrives on the API as `jobTitleName` (an always-included field, not one we request). Count verified against the array; do not hand-edit one without the other.
values: Executive Vice President of Human Resources

departments.$comment: 12 options. Arrives as `departmentName`; 911 of 1851 records carried one. The sync creates a row in our own `department` table for each name it meets.

divisions.$comment: Read off a screenshot of the Division select, so treat as POSSIBLY INCOMPLETE — the visible options ran C-E-E-E-O-S alphabetically with no way to tell whether the list scrolled. Verify before relying on it being closed. Arrives as `divisionName`; 920 of 1851 records carried one.

observations: Division and Department are NOT cleanly hierarchical: 'Estimating' and 'Safety' each appear in both lists. Do not build anything that assumes a division contains departments.
The Optix team-role ladder uses 'Area In-charge', which does not exist as a BambooHR job title. The nearest HR titles are 'Area Manager' and 'Area Superintendent'.
'General Superintendent' exists in both BambooHR and the Optix ladder, spelled identically.

There is no plain 'Director' title. HR has 'Director of Civil Operations', 'Director of Estimating- Water Department', 'Director of Project Controls' and 'Project Director', so the Optix 'Director' tier maps from several HR titles.
Nine titles contain 'Foreman' and six contain 'Superintendent', which is why substring matching cannot produce the tier — 'Assistant Superintendent' would become a full Superintendent.
The demo fixture seeds divisions 'Operations', 'Heavy Civil' and 'Utilities'. Only 'Operations' is a real BambooHR division; 'Heavy Civil' is a real DEPARTMENT, and 'Utilities' matches neither.
